notes.title: SYMMETRY V2.0 - NOW AVAILABLE IN 10 LANGUAGES
notes.content:
SYMMETRY HAS GONE INTERNATIONAL IN THE V2.0 UPDATE!
The intense platformer is now available in 9 new languages, with more to be added soon.

AVAILABLE LANGUAGES:
French, German, Spanish (Spain), Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

Other languages soon to be released include: Italian & Turkish

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544108/ae25afe16bb498b16065153bc4c1530500f88f62.jpg

GAME UPDATES
Alongside this, there have been updates to the gameplay, including:

Timer reset at the start of a level (Solo Mode)
If the player respawns at the start of a level, the timer will automatically reset, saving the player reloading the level to try again.

Bug fixes

Updated button/key bindings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544108/8dbd85e6f46166e9cb6621062ba3b11a9b34a392.jpg

A NEW MODE COMING SOON
The ball doesn't stop rolling here, because the new mode 'RUSH' will be following the V2.0 update very soon! This will take place on a brand new track.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544108/d7e01c027b58af0f14d36eb33a8319150b8b0143.jpg

Have you tested your nerve in Symmetry yet?
